title: A Six-Dimensional Symmetry and Density Oscillation Model for Unifying Relativity and Quantum Mechanics and Compressed Quantum Information Transfer via Riemann Prime Distribution
content: We present a six-dimensional symmetric model unifying relativity and quantum mechanics through density oscillations and the Riemann prime distribution. Density in four-dimensional space acts as a rotating length around mass fields, with additional rotation in five dimensions and spatial expansion in six dimensions via repeated matter wave states. The arrow of time arises from geometric potential differences caused by density variations and elliptical eccentricity, linking oscillatory motion near light speed to three orthogonal time dimensions. Past, present, and future exist as real dimensions. This unifies mass motion through space-time with quantum principles. Quantum mechanics and general relativity reconcile via prime number distribution on the critical line of the Riemann zeta function. The model explains general entanglement and space-time structure through prime groups and wormhole-mediated Möbius geometry.
